what: When you hover one row of the stacked menu rows (like a pile of cassette tapes), that row stays in place at 0°, rows above move up and rows below move down by 45 + 5 × the number of slots away px, each wobbling randomly ±5° (1s circ.out). When you leave the pile only the height returns to place and the wobbled angles stay

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Children that step aside — document order runs top to bottom
options.base: Distance the nearest line moves aside (px), default 45
options.step: Distance added for each step farther away (px), default 5
options.spin: Max shake angle (deg), default 5 — 0 means no shaking
options.reset: If all, the angle is also 0 on release

note: Not applied on touch devices (no hover)

from.where: shared.js menu drawer — eight cassette tape lines
